beaches.name: Tsamadou
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is customary at the eastern end, right of the snack bar. The Samos regional-unit tourism page calls it a formerly well-known nudist beach with few nudists today; a naturist directory carries consistent visitor reports from 1999 to 2018. No decree or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Fournaki
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is usual in the string of coves west of the main Votsalakia beach. A naturist directory carries consistent reports from 2000 to August 2024; the 2024 report finds the coves clothing-optional to fully nude. The first cove with sunbeds is swimwear; no designation is documented.
